steps.title: Start from Services
steps.body: Click on Services to see open care packages on CareMate.

steps.title: Find suitable services
steps.body: You can search by service name or filter by categories to find what you need.

steps.title: Select a service category
steps.body: Category buttons help you filter quickly based on needs, e.g., postpartum care, baby care, or long-term packages.

steps.title: Select a service
steps.body: Open a service card to see details on pricing, duration, and included items.

steps.title: View service details
steps.body: Check category, sessions, duration, and estimated costs before proceeding to select a nurse.

steps.title: Proceed to nurse selection
steps.body: After reviewing details, click Book Now to see available nurses.

steps.title: Filter nurses
steps.body: This list is pre-filtered for the service. You can search by name, filter by region, or sort by rating, distance, experience.

steps.title: Select a nurse profile
steps.body: Open a nurse profile to view experience, reviews, and available time slots.

steps.title: Select date and time
steps.body: Only available slots for the nurse are shown here. Pick a time suitable for your family.

steps.title: Click on desired time slot
steps.body: When the slot changes color, it is selected. For multi-session packages, pick enough slots for each day.

steps.title: Enter service address
steps.body: Enter address so the nurse knows where to go. If the map is enabled, you can pinpoint the location.

steps.title: Complete booking
steps.body: Double check information and click continue. If not logged in, you will be redirected to the login page first.
